text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp successfully came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~.
That training camp was over in the blink of an eye, wasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Truly.
But—I saw it through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I am truly looking forward to the Shuka Sho~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It turned out to be a thoroughly fulfilling summer camp
where both could feel real progress!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The blazing summer has passed—and at last, the splendid flowers of autumn bloom in full glory.
